tagline: Every video, exactly how you want it
brief: The Windows version of Media MultiTool, my full-control yt-dlp app: exact resolutions, codecs, trims, GIFs and subtitles from YouTube, Instagram, X and 1,800+ sites. The logo is the phone logo's family: the same chevron, baseline pill and top slot, now inside a laptop.
criteria: Success: obviously a sibling of the phone logo, reads as laptop + download at 24 px, black tile with silver mark, no gradients on the lettering.

concepts.name: Laptop
concepts.idea: The phone logo's download sign, on a laptop screen with the base set apart.
rationale: Same chevron, baseline pill, slot and silver finish as the phone logo, so the two apps read as one family
Custom lettering drawn with the same strokes as the symbol, no font licence needed
A separate heavier cut without the webcam slot for 32 px and below

recommendation: Final artwork: silver laptop on the black gradient tile for the app icon, flat black or silver everywhere else.
next_steps: Use mmd-app-icon.ico as the Windows app icon
Use the horizontal lockup in the README and the app header
